## EP

```{r}
# https://github.com/cunni/epmgp/blob/master/epmgp.m

library(ggplot2)

# -------------------------------------------------------------------
# EP Algorithm for Monotonic Constraints
# -------------------------------------------------------------------

enforce_monotonic <- function(kappa_estimates,
                              sigma_gp = 0.05,
                              # GP scale parameter
                              length_scale = 5,
                              # GP length scale (smoothness)
                              max_iter = 100,
                              tol = 1e-6,
                              damping = 0.3) {
  # Damping factor for stability

  n <- length(kappa_estimates)

  # -----------------------------------------------------------------
  # 1. PRIOR: Gaussian Process with Squared Exponential Kernel
  #    Zero mean GP (more stable than using estimates as mean)
  # -----------------------------------------------------------------
  prior_mean <- rep(0, n)

  # Squared Exponential (RBF) kernel - smooth, stationary
  prior_covariance <- matrix(0, n, n)
  for (i in 1:n) {
    for (j in 1:n) {
      # sigma^2 * exp(-(i-j)^2/(2*length_scale^2))
      prior_covariance[i, j] <- sigma_gp^2 * exp(-(i - j)^2 / (2 * length_scale^2))
    }
  }

  # Add small jitter for numerical stability
  prior_covariance <- prior_covariance + diag(1e-8, n)

  # -----------------------------------------------------------------
  # 2. LIKELIHOOD: Use kappa_estimates as noisy observations
  # -----------------------------------------------------------------
  # Rough estimate of observation noise (difference between adjacent points)
  obs_noise_var <- var(diff(kappa_estimates)) / 2
  obs_noise_var <- max(obs_noise_var, 1e-4)  # Ensure positive

  # Combine prior and likelihood to get initial posterior
  precision_prior <- solve(prior_covariance)
  precision_likelihood <- diag(1 / obs_noise_var, n)

  posterior_covariance <- solve(precision_prior + precision_likelihood)
  posterior_mean <- posterior_covariance %*% (kappa_estimates / obs_noise_var)

  # -----------------------------------------------------------------
  # 3. CONSTRAINTS: Monotonic increasing (κ_{i+1} - κ_i >= 0)
  # -----------------------------------------------------------------
  num_constraints <- n - 1
  constraint_matrix <- matrix(0, n, num_constraints)
  for (i in 1:num_constraints) {
    constraint_matrix[i, i] <- -1
    constraint_matrix[i + 1, i] <- 1
  }

  # Bounds: differences must be >= 0
  lower_bound <- rep(0, num_constraints)
  upper_bound <- rep(Inf, num_constraints)

  # -----------------------------------------------------------------
  # 4. INITIALIZE EP SITE PARAMETERS
  # -----------------------------------------------------------------
  tau_site <- rep(0, num_constraints)  # Site precisions
  nu_site <- rep(0, num_constraints)   # Site scaled means

  # -----------------------------------------------------------------
  # 5. EP ITERATIONS
  # -----------------------------------------------------------------
  for (iter in 1:max_iter) {
    previous_mean <- posterior_mean

    # Randomly permute constraint order for better convergence
    constraint_order <- sample(1:num_constraints)

    for (j_idx in seq_along(constraint_order)) {
      j <- constraint_order[j_idx]
      constraint_vector <- constraint_matrix[, j]

      # -----------------------------------------------------------------
      # Cavity distribution: remove site j from posterior
      # -----------------------------------------------------------------
      sigma_c_constraint <- posterior_covariance %*% constraint_vector
      constraint_variance <- as.numeric(t(constraint_vector) %*% sigma_c_constraint)

      # Cavity parameters (natural form)
      tau_cavity <- 1 / constraint_variance - tau_site[j]
      nu_cavity <- as.numeric(t(constraint_vector) %*% posterior_mean) / constraint_variance - nu_site[j]

      # Ensure positive precision
      if (tau_cavity <= 0) {
        tau_cavity <- 1e-6
        nu_cavity <- 0
      }

      # Convert to moment form
      mu_cavity <- nu_cavity / tau_cavity
      sigma2_cavity <- 1 / tau_cavity

      # -----------------------------------------------------------------
      # Moments of truncated normal (constraint: difference >= 0)
      # -----------------------------------------------------------------
      moments <- truncated_normal_moments(lower_bound[j], upper_bound[j], mu_cavity, sigma2_cavity)

      # Skip if moments are degenerate
      if (!is.finite(moments$truncated_variance) ||
          moments$truncated_variance < 1e-12) {
        next
      }

      # -----------------------------------------------------------------
      # Site update: match moments of tilted distribution
      # -----------------------------------------------------------------
      tau_target <- 1 / moments$truncated_variance
      nu_target <- moments$truncated_mean / moments$truncated_variance

      # Compute site parameter updates
      delta_tau_site <- tau_target - tau_cavity - tau_site[j]
      delta_nu_site <- nu_target - nu_cavity - nu_site[j]

      # Apply damping for stability
      tau_site[j] <- tau_site[j] + damping * delta_tau_site
      nu_site[j] <- nu_site[j] + damping * delta_nu_site

      # Ensure site precision is positive
      tau_site[j] <- max(tau_site[j], 1e-8)

      # -----------------------------------------------------------------
      # Update posterior with rank-1 Sherman-Morrison
      # -----------------------------------------------------------------
      delta_tau <- tau_site[j] - (1 / constraint_variance - tau_cavity)

      if (abs(delta_tau) > 1e-12) {
        denominator <- 1 + delta_tau * constraint_variance
        if (abs(denominator) > 1e-12) {
          # Update covariance
          posterior_covariance <- posterior_covariance -
            (delta_tau / denominator) * (sigma_c_constraint %*% t(sigma_c_constraint))

          # Update mean
          posterior_mean <- posterior_mean +
            ((
              nu_site[j] - (
                as.numeric(t(constraint_vector) %*% posterior_mean) /
                  constraint_variance - nu_cavity
              ) - delta_tau *
                as.numeric(t(constraint_vector) %*% posterior_mean)
            ) / denominator) *
            sigma_c_constraint
        }
      }
    }

    # -----------------------------------------------------------------
    # Check convergence
    # -----------------------------------------------------------------
    mean_change <- sqrt(sum((posterior_mean - previous_mean)^2)) / sqrt(sum(previous_mean^2))
    if (mean_change < tol && iter > 5) {
      break
    }
  }

  # -----------------------------------------------------------------
  # Return results
  # -----------------------------------------------------------------
  list(
    original = kappa_estimates,
    smoothed = as.numeric(posterior_mean),
    prior_covariance = prior_covariance,
    posterior_covariance = posterior_covariance,
    sigma_gp = sigma_gp,
    length_scale = length_scale,
    obs_noise_var = obs_noise_var,
    iterations = iter,
    converged = iter < max_iter,
    tau_site = tau_site,
    nu_site = nu_site
  )
}

# -------------------------------------------------------------------
# Moments of truncated normal distribution
# -------------------------------------------------------------------
truncated_normal_moments <- function(lower, upper, mean, variance) {
  # Handle numerical issues
  if (variance <= 0) {
    return(list(
      truncated_mean = mean,
      truncated_variance = 0
    ))
  }

  sigma <- sqrt(variance)

  # Standardized bounds
  if (is.infinite(lower)) {
    alpha <- -Inf
  } else {
    alpha <- (lower - mean) / sigma
  }

  if (is.infinite(upper)) {
    beta <- Inf
  } else {
    beta <- (upper - mean) / sigma
  }

  # Handle special cases
  if (is.infinite(alpha) && is.infinite(beta)) {
    return(list(
      truncated_mean = mean,
      truncated_variance = variance
    ))
  }

  if (is.infinite(beta)) {
    # Lower truncation only
    if (alpha > 10) {
      # Far in tail - approximate
      phi_alpha <- dnorm(alpha, log = TRUE)
      Phi_alpha <- pnorm(alpha, lower.tail = FALSE, log.p = TRUE)
      lambda <- exp(phi_alpha - Phi_alpha)
      delta <- lambda * (lambda - alpha)

      truncated_mean <- mean + sigma * lambda
      truncated_variance <- variance * (1 - delta)
    } else {
      # Regular case
      Phi_alpha <- pnorm(alpha, lower.tail = FALSE)
      if (Phi_alpha < 1e-300) {
        truncated_mean <- lower
        truncated_variance <- 0
      } else {
        lambda <- dnorm(alpha) / Phi_alpha
        delta <- lambda * (lambda - alpha)

        truncated_mean <- mean + sigma * lambda
        truncated_variance <- variance * (1 - delta)
      }
    }
  } else {
    # Double truncation - shouldn't happen for monotonic constraints
    Z <- pnorm(beta) - pnorm(alpha)
    if (Z < 1e-300) {
      truncated_mean <- (lower + upper) / 2
      truncated_variance <- 0
    } else {
      phi_alpha <- dnorm(alpha)
      phi_beta <- dnorm(beta)

      truncated_mean <- mean + sigma * (phi_alpha - phi_beta) / Z

      second_moment <- mean^2 + variance +
        sigma^2 * (alpha * phi_alpha - beta * phi_beta) / Z
      truncated_variance <- second_moment - truncated_mean^2
    }
  }

  # Ensure non-negative variance
  truncated_variance <- max(truncated_variance, 0)

  list(truncated_mean = truncated_mean, truncated_variance = truncated_variance)
}

# -------------------------------------------------------------------
# Plot function for EP results
# -------------------------------------------------------------------
plot_ep_result <- function(ep_result,
                           title = NULL,
                           y_limits = NULL) {
  if (!is.list(ep_result) || !"original" %in% names(ep_result)) {
    stop("Input is not a valid EP result object")
  }

  plot_data <- data.frame(
    age_group = rep(1:length(ep_result$original), 2),
    rate = c(rev(ep_result$original), rev(ep_result$smoothed)),
    type = rep(c("Original", "EP-Smoothed"), each = length(ep_result$original))
  )

  # Use provided title or default
  if (is.null(title)) {
    title <- "Monotonic Smoothing with EP (GP Prior)"
  }

  p <- ggplot(plot_data, aes(
    x = age_group,
    y = rate,
    color = type,
    group = type
  )) +
    geom_line(aes(linetype = type), size = 1) +
    geom_point(size = 1) +
    labs(
      title = title,
      subtitle = paste(
        "Iterations:",
        ep_result$iterations,
        ifelse(ep_result$converged, "(converged)", "(not converged)"),
        "| σ_gp =",
        ep_result$sigma_gp,
        "| ℓ =",
        ep_result$length_scale
      ),
      x = "Index",
      y = "Value"
    ) +
    scale_color_manual(values = c("Original" = "red", "EP-Smoothed" = "blue")) +
    scale_linetype_manual(values = c("Original" = "dashed", "EP-Smoothed" = "solid")) +
    theme_minimal() +
    theme(
      legend.position = "bottom",
      plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, face = "bold"),
      legend.title = element_blank()
    )

  # Add y-axis limits if specified
  if (!is.null(y_limits)) {
    p <- p + ylim(y_limits[1], y_limits[2])
  }

  return(p)
}
```

Small sigma = less enforcement = less smooth
Large sigma = more enforcement = more smooth

```{r}
result_sigma_3 <- enforce_monotonic(rev_kappa1, sigma_gp = 0.05, length_scale = 5)
plot_ep_result(result_sigma_3)

result_sigma_4 <- enforce_monotonic(rev_kappa1, sigma_gp = 0.1, length_scale = 5)
plot_ep_result(result_sigma_4)

result_sigma_5 <- enforce_monotonic(rev_kappa1, sigma_gp = 0.5, length_scale = 5)
plot_ep_result(result_sigma_5)
```

```{r, cache = TRUE}
mort_CBD <- StMoMoData(US_data, type = "initial", series = "total")
N <- 1e6
mort_CBD$Dxt <- round(mort_CBD$Dxt * N)
mort_CBD$Ext <- round(mort_CBD$Ext * N)

# Fit CBD
# Binomial Distribution
CBD <- cbd(link = "logit")
CBDfit <- fit(CBD, data = (mort_CBD), ages.fit = 25:65, years.fit=1933:1983)
CBDfit
```

```{r}
# Ages and years actually used in the CBD model
ages_fit  <- CBDfit$ages
years_fit <- CBDfit$years
year_idx <- match(years_fit, mort_CBD$years)

# Extract deaths & exposures for those ages
Dxt_fit <- mort_CBD$Dxt[match(ages_fit, mort_CBD$ages), year_idx]
Ext_fit <- mort_CBD$Ext[match(ages_fit, mort_CBD$ages), year_idx]

# Observed initial death probabilities q_{x,t}
qxt_obs_CBD <- Dxt_fit / Ext_fit

# Fitted q_{x,t} from CBD model
qxt_fit_CBD <- fitted(CBDfit, type = "rates")   # matrix: age x year

ages_to_plot <- c(30, 40, 50, 60)   # all must be in ages_fit
age_index    <- match(ages_to_plot, ages_fit)

plot_list_CBD <- vector("list", length(ages_to_plot))

for (i in seq_along(age_index)) {
  age <- ages_to_plot[i]
  idx <- age_index[i]

  df <- data.frame(
    year     = years_fit,
    observed = qxt_obs_CBD[idx, ],
    fitted   = qxt_fit_CBD[idx, ]
  )

  df_melt <- melt(df, id.vars = "year")

  p <- ggplot(df_melt, aes(x = year, y = value, color = variable)) +
    geom_line(size = 0.9) +
    scale_y_log10() +   # log scale for probabilities (optional but consistent)
    labs(title = paste("Age", age, ": CBD Mortality"),
         y = "death probability (log scale)", x = "year",
         color = "") +
    theme_minimal()

  plot_list_CBD[[i]] <- p
}

grid.arrange(
  plot_list_CBD[[1]], plot_list_CBD[[2]], plot_list_CBD[[3]], plot_list_CBD[[4]],
```

## DM Test

```{r}
get_fc_rates_vec <- function(fc, ages) {
  r <- fc$rates
  if (is.null(dim(r))) {
    v <- r
  } else {
    v <- r[, 1]
  }
  v <- as.numeric(v)
  names(v) <- rownames(as.matrix(fc$rates)) %||% names(fc$rates) # optional, but safer

  # best: just reorder by ages using names when available
  if (!is.null(names(fc$rates)) || !is.null(rownames(as.matrix(fc$rates)))) {
    nm <- if (!is.null(names(fc$rates))) names(fc$rates) else rownames(as.matrix(fc$rates))
    names(v) <- nm
    v <- v[as.character(ages)]
  }
  v
}
```

```{r}
# Define loss function 
# Binomial Deviance
binom_deviance_cell <- function(D, E, qhat) {
  qhat <- pmin(pmax(qhat, 1e-12), 1 - 1e-12)
  mu <- E * qhat

  term1 <- ifelse(D == 0, 0, D * log(D / mu))
  term2 <- ifelse(D == E, 0, (E - D) * log((E - D) / (E - mu)))

  2 * (term1 + term2)
}

# average
loss_per_year_binom_dev_avg <- function(D_obs, E_obs, q_hat) {
  dev_mat <- binom_deviance_cell(D_obs, E_obs, q_hat)
  colMeans(dev_mat, na.rm = TRUE)
}
```

Normal CBD 

```{r}
ages <- 25:65
years <- 1933:2023
evalYears <- 2003:2023
origins <- evalYears - 1
mort_F <- StMoMoData(US_data, type = "central", series = "total")

# CBD data
mort_CBD_for <- StMoMoData(US_data, type = "initial", series = "total")

# observed exposure
obs_exp_CBD <- mort_CBD_for$Ext[ages + 1, years %in% evalYears, drop = FALSE]

# observed death count
obs_death <- matrix(NA_real_, nrow = length(ages), ncol = length(evalYears),
                     dimnames = list(as.character(ages), as.character(evalYears)))

# observed exposure
obs_exp <- matrix(NA_real_, nrow = length(ages), ncol = length(evalYears),
                     dimnames = list(as.character(ages), as.character(evalYears)))

N <- 1e6
mort_CBD_for$Dxt <- round(mort_CBD_for$Dxt * N)
mort_CBD_for$Ext <- round(mort_CBD_for$Ext * N)
CBD <- cbd(link = "logit")

# forecast mortality prob
qx_hat_CBD <- matrix(NA_real_, nrow = length(ages), ncol = length(evalYears),
                     dimnames = list(as.character(ages), as.character(evalYears)))

for (i in seq_along(origins)) {
  T <- origins[i]
  fitCBD_f <- fit(CBD, data = mort_CBD_for, ages.fit = 25:65, years.fit = 1933:T)

  fcCBD <- forecast(fitCBD_f, h=1, level=95)

  qx_hat_CBD[, as.character(T+1)] <- get_fc_rates_vec(fcCBD, ages)
  
  # extract observed count in forecast year
  obs_death[, as.character(T+1)] <- mort_F$Dxt[ages+1,years == T+1]
  # observed exposure
  obs_exp[, as.character(T+1)] <- mort_F$Ext[ages+1,years == T+1]
}
```

EP-adjusted

```{r}
# forecast mortality prob
qx_hat_CBD_EP <- matrix(NA_real_, nrow = length(ages), ncol = length(evalYears),
                     dimnames = list(as.character(ages), as.character(evalYears)))

for (i in seq_along(origins)) {
  T <- origins[i]
  fitCBD_f <- fit(CBD, data = mort_CBD_for, ages.fit = 25:65, years.fit = 1933:T)
  
  ### EP-adjustment 
  final_kappa <- fitCBD_f$kt[1, ]
  final_kappa_rev <- rev(final_kappa)
  
  final_ep_fit <- enforce_monotonic(final_kappa_rev, sigma_gp = 0.1, length_scale = 5)
  smoothed_kappa_rev <- rev(final_ep_fit$smoothed)
  
  fitCBD_f_adj <- fitCBD_f
  fitCBD_f_adj$kt[1, ] <- smoothed_kappa_rev
  class(fitCBD_f_adj) <- class(fitCBD_f)
  ###

  fcCBD <- forecast(fitCBD_f_adj, h=1, level=95)

  qx_hat_CBD_EP[, as.character(T+1)] <- get_fc_rates_vec(fcCBD, ages)
}
```


```{r}
L_CBD_dev_avg <- loss_per_year_binom_dev_avg(obs_death, obs_exp_CBD, qx_hat_CBD)

L_CBD_dev_avg <- ts(L_CBD_dev_avg, start = min(evalYears), frequency = 1)

L_CBD_dev_avg_EP <- loss_per_year_binom_dev_avg(obs_death, obs_exp_CBD, qx_hat_CBD_EP)

L_CBD_dev_avg_EP <- ts(L_CBD_dev_avg_EP, start = min(evalYears), frequency = 1)

dm.test(as.numeric(L_CBD_dev_avg), as.numeric(L_CBD_dev_avg_EP), alternative = "two.sided", 
        h = 1, power = 1)
```
